text:
Elaine Rivera: FYI nightly link-scan flagged several 404s on docs/onboarding-guide.html (staging). A few runtime example links + an old api path. Not urgent but user-facing. Can someone own triage?
Matt K: I can take a look this morning. Do we have the exact list?
link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-22T05:12Z — 9 dead internal links found in docs/onboarding-guide.html. Examples: /runtime/examples/quick-batch, /runtime/examples/kv-tune, /api/v1/old-generate. Full: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/1719019999
Irina Cho: I touched that file in Feb when we moved example repos. Prob broke the permalinks. I can submit a patch in a bit.
Matt K: Thanks. If you're editing, please update /runtime/examples/* -> /examples/runtime/* and /api/v1/old-generate -> /api/v2/generate. Add a changelog line in the PR body about the endpoint rename. Tag me for CR.
Irina Cho: will do. Quick local fix I ran:
```bash
rg "runtime/examples/quick-batch|api/v1/old-generate|runtime/examples/kv-tune" -n docs/ && \
sed -i 's@/runtime/examples/@/examples/runtime/@g' docs/onboarding-guide.html && \
sed -i 's@/api/v1/old-generate@/api/v2/generate@g' docs/onboarding-guide.html
```
Matt K: nice. One tiny nit: move the single-line sample into a fenced block so it renders better in the guide.
Irina Cho: pushed that tweak. Opening PR now.
docs-oncall: heads-up: if this is low-risk and CI passes we can merge to get staging fixed before the next scan.
Irina Cho: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/7721 — includes permalinks fix + changelog note and the fenced sample tweak. Tagging @Matt K for CR.
Matt K: reviewing now. rapid CR. LGTM after one nit (typo in changelog line).
Irina Cho: fixed the typo, force-pushed.
Matt K: CI is green. Merging.
link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled post-merge.
Elaine Rivera: great, thanks everyone. I'll watch the re-scan and reopen if anything else pops up. :pray:
